description.value:
Duration 1 round

Saving Throw Will vs. your class DC

Your reading presses hard enough to be felt. When you Diagnose an unwilling creature, it attempts a Will save against your class DC; on a failure it becomes sickened 1 for 1 round. A creature that has attempted this save cannot be forced to attempt it again for 10 minutes. Diagnosing a willing creature, or a corpse, requires no save and has no effect.

cinderfall.incomplete: Diagnosis is this class's own signature action (per the class card's flags.cinderfall.terms entry, classes.plaguesworn.json:82). A corpus-wide search (find site/data/cards -iname "*diagnos*") turns up only unrelated Old World Construct ancestry cards plus the three plaguesworn feats that reference it -- there is no "Diagnosis" action card anywhere in the corpus for a feat that keys off "when you Diagnose" to hook into or modify. No action card exists for this to hook a triggered save onto.
